auth: JWT RS256 (existant). EmailVerifiedGuard global actif. CurrentUser.sub = userId.
delivery: INERTE: video_enabled absent/'false' => aucun upload/publication video possible en prod.

conventions.validation: Tout body via Zod + ZodValidationPipe (idem existant).
conventions.media_binding: Ne jamais persister une URL client brute: passer par S3Service.assertOwnedPublicMedia.
conventions.privacy: Story video = visibility 'friends' (herite de createStory). Feed filtre par friendIds. Bucket public + UUID (parite images).

video_enabled.reason: settings.getSetting('video_enabled','false') renvoie 'false' si Redis ET DB echouent => panne = video OFF.

verifiedOnly.note: Lire la DB (pas le claim JWT) pour ne pas dependre d'un token perime. Modele: association.service.ts:43-45.

onFail.message: Publier une video est reserve aux comptes verifies.

limits.maxVideoBytesEnforced: SERVEUR via HEAD ContentLength dans assertOwnedPublicMedia

quota.activeVideosSource: DB COUNT(post WHERE authorId, isStory, deletedAt null, storyExpiresAt>now, media.mediaType='video')

limits.note: Augmenter maxVideoBytes ou quota au-dela du budget disque = GO PROPRIO (impact disjoncteur).

uploadsDaily.op: INCR a chaque create video reussi; TTL 86400s; refus si valeur > 5

bytesDaily.op: INCRBY(ContentLength) APRES binding reussi; TTL 86400s; refus si cumul > 209715200

redisKeys.note: Compteurs journaliers (reset minuit UTC), pas glissants — acceptable beta. Vidéos actives = DB (autoritatif), pas Redis.

guardMethod.signature: assertOwnedPublicMedia(url: string, expectedMediaType: 'image'|'video', requiredPrefix: string): Promise<string>
logic: realKind = image si realType in ALLOWED_IMAGE_TYPES; video si in ALLOWED_VIDEO_TYPES; sinon 400 MEDIA_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED
si realKind !== expectedMediaType => 400 MEDIA_TYPE_MISMATCH (ferme le spoof)
cap = image?15Mo:25Mo; si ContentLength > cap => 400 MEDIA_TOO_LARGE

keyLayout.reason: Prefixe de tete 'stories/' pour permettre mc ilm (filtre prefixe racine) sans toucher au media permanent.

s3.sse: sseRequired renvoye tel quel (false sur MinIO)

body.publicUrl: string (URL CDN canonique a renvoyer au create)

429.description: Throttle ou quota uploadsDaily depasse (code UPLOAD_QUOTA_EXCEEDED)

gates: si mediaType=video: killSwitch + verifiedOnly + quota(active<10, bytes<200Mo/24h)
endpoints.description: Creer une story (image OU video). Video: binding anti-spoof + quotas + compteurs.

requestZodSchema.name: createStorySchema (EXISTANT, inchange)
requestZodSchema.postMediaSchema: z.object({ mediaUrl: z.string().url().max(500), thumbnailUrl: z.string().url().max(500).optional(), mediaType: z.enum(['image','video']), width: z.number().int().positive().optional(), height: z.number().int().positive().optional(), blurhash: z.string().max(100).optional(), sortOrder: z.number().int().min(0).optional() })

serverLogic: si video: identityStatus DB==='approved' sinon 403 IDENTITY_NOT_APPROVED
bind = assertOwnedPublicMedia(media.mediaUrl, media.mediaType, `stories/${userId}/`)  (fixe cap 25Mo/15Mo + anti-spoof + ownership)
create Post{isStory:true, visibility:'friends', storyExpiresAt: now+24h} + PostMedia
si video: INCR video:uploads:{u}:{day} (TTL 24h) + INCRBY video:bytes:{u}:{day} (ContentLength)

400.description: MEDIA_URL_INVALID | MEDIA_NOT_OWNED | MEDIA_NOT_FOUND | MEDIA_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED | MEDIA_TYPE_MISMATCH | MEDIA_TOO_LARGE

endpoints.description: Supprimer sa story + PURGER l'objet S3 (corrige la dette).
serverLogic: pour chaque PostMedia: key=parsePublicKey(mediaUrl); si key: s3.deleteObject(key) best-effort (+thumbnail)

endpoints.requestZodSchema: createReportSchema (EXISTANT): { targetType:'post', targetId: uuid, reason: enum, description?: string<=1000 }

endpoints.description: Takedown: action 'content_removed' => purge S3 des PostMedia PUIS soft-delete.
serverLogic: moderation.service.removeContent(type='post', id): charger post.media; deleteObject par media; puis post.deletedAt=now

endpoints.description: Armer/desarmer le kill-switch video (rearmement disjoncteur apres purge).
endpoints.requestPatch: ajouter champ optionnel { videoEnabled?: boolean } -> setSetting('video_enabled', bool?'true':'false')

layerA_cronPurge.logic: findMany(stories expirees, include media) par batch (~200); pour chaque media: parsePublicKey -> deleteObject best-effort (+thumbnail); PUIS updateMany(deletedAt). Idem deleteStory (manuel) et removeContent (takedown).

layerB_minioLifecycle.fallbackSyntax: mc ilm add --expiry-days 2 --prefix "stories/" local/${S3_BUCKET} (selon version mc)
layerB_minioLifecycle.role: Backstop ~48h si le cron A echoue durablement. Ne touche jamais 'users/'.

layerC_diskGuard.read: GET http://minio:9000/minio/v2/metrics/cluster -> metrique minio_bucket_usage_total_bytes{bucket=S3_BUCKET} (scanner interne MinIO, ZERO CPU API)
layerC_diskGuard.rearm: MANUEL uniquement (admin PATCH /admin/settings). Jamais de reactivation auto.
layerC_diskGuard.onMetricsError: log warn; NE PAS reactiver (fail-safe: on ne relache pas la garde sur incertitude).
